verdict.rationale: Compliance SaaS platforms with AI features could plausibly let users plug in external MCP servers, so this axis applies. The evidence only shows Drata's server side: an official MCP server (drata-probe-4) and docs on letting AI agents interact with Drata. Those are about external agents consuming Drata's tools, not Drata consuming tools from MCP servers. That evidence comes from a different story and does not transfer, so nothing shows Drata acting as an MCP client.
